title: Find the busiest hour
prompt: Write peakHour(counts: number[]): number. counts[i] is the number of tasks opened during hour i. Return the hour (the index) with the most tasks. If two hours tie, return the earlier one. Return -1 for an empty list.
hints: Track the best index seen so far.
Only replace it when a count is strictly larger.
Decide what an empty list returns before the loop.

wrongAnswers.misconception: Returns the largest count instead of its hour.
Returns the later hour on a tie.

feedback: Return a position, not a count. Check an empty list and a tie.
